name: aippocampus
description: Source-backed continuity for Codex agents: find old cues, reopen local source, and continue honestly.

interface.shortDescription: Recover source-backed conversation continuity from old cues.
interface.longDescription: AIppocampus gives a Codex agent an explicit local continuity path with privacy boundaries visible: verify the plugin, offer trusted Codex hooks/action hints with rollback, then recall and deepen one source-backed route. Silent auto-enable: no. Recommended trusted setup: yes when this machine is allowed to run local continuity hooks. Summaries, scents, and Dream/subconscious findings stay navigation until source reopen; optional provider-backed routes enable only when a key is visible, with a no-key source-backed fallback.
defaultPrompt: Find one source-backed AIppocampus recall for this old cue.
Reopen the source trail behind this AIppocampus route.
Check AIppocampus readiness before continuing this thread.
